tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: On January 28, 2025 Company had received copy of order in Form DRC-22 from Office of Joint Commissioner of State Tax, Investigation-B, Mumbai directing Union Bank of India and State Bank of India to provisionally attach (debit freeze) the operative bank account of the Company held in these banks. On February 5, 2025 the Company had received copy of order in Form DRC-23 directing Union Bank of India and State Bank of India to restore (un freeze) the provisionally attached operative bank account of the Company held with these banks. These orders were issued pursuant to the intimation of Tax ascertained amounting to Rs. 13.36 Crores along with applicable interest and penalty under Section 74(5) of MGST Act, 2017 for voluntary payment, for which reply was already submitted and the matter was pending with GST Department. In continuation of the same, the Company received the Show Cause Notice on the matter in respect of the financial year 2018-19 during Q1 FY 26 and in repect of the financial year 2019-20 during Q2 FY 26. The reply on these Show Cause Notices are already submitted.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Office of Joint Commissioner of State Tax, Investigation-B, Mumbai
tax_litigation.status: With respect to the GST related dispute as mentioned in the previous quarter: 1. The Company have received the order passed by Assistant Commissioner of State Tax in Form DRC-07 amounting to Rs. 2,00,41,296/- for the financial year 2018-19. The Company is in process for filing an appeal before the appropriate authority. 2. During Q3 FY26, the Company received the Show Cause Notices for the matters pertaining to financial years 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 and upto June 30 of financial year 2024-25. The reply on these Show Cause Notice are already submitted.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: On October 6, 2025, the Company received the order passed by the Hon'ble High Court allowing the writ petition filed by the Company and setting aside the order issued by CGST & C.Ex. Authority
tax_litigation.status: The matter has been challenged by the GST Department before the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India by way of a Special Leave Petition (Civil), against the judgment and order dated October 6, 2025 passed by the Hon’ble High Court in favour of the Company, wherein the order issued by the CGST & Central Excise Authorities was set aside. The Company has duly lodged a Caveat Petition in the matter.

The Company is in process for filing an appeal before the appropriate authority. 2. The reply on these Show Cause Notice are already submitted.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company received the Special Leave Petition (Civil) filed by the GST Department before the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India, challenging the judgment and order dated October 6, 2025, passed by the Hon’ble High Court in favour of the Company. The Company thereafter duly filed a Caveat Petition before the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India. tax_litigation.status: With respect to the previous disclosure, the captioned matter, along with the connected matters, the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India, vide its order (as informed to theExchange vide our communication dated August 10, 2026 with reference number ADL/SE/2026-27/37), dismissed the Special Leave Petition filed by the GST Department.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: With respect to the GST-related dispute, as disclosed in the previous quarter: (1) personal hearings in the appeal pertaining to FY 2018-19 were attended, and written submissions were filed before the Appellate Authority. The matter was pending adjudication before the Appellate Authority; and (2) an appeal against the order pertaining to FY 2019-20 was duly filed and admitted by the Appellate Authority.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Office of Joint Commissioner of State Tax, Investigation-B, Mumbai
tax_litigation.status: With respect to the GST-related dispute, as disclosed in the previous quarter: (1) the Appellate Authority passed the Order-in-Appeal, in respect of FY 2018–19, and the filing of an appeal before the GST Appellate Tribunal against the said order is currently under process; and (2) in respect of FY 2019–20, the personal hearing was attended. also the filing of additional written submissions was made. The matter is presently pending adjudication before the Appellate Authority.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹720.3 Cr (+6.4% YoY), net profit ₹55.26 Cr (-12.0% YoY).
Aarti Drugs reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹721.1 Cr (+6% YoY) and PAT of ₹55.3 Cr (-12% YoY), alongside a full year revenue of ₹2,567.7 Cr.
Rushikesh Deole, Company Secretary, uploaded the audio recording of the Q1FY27/Annual Results conference call on May 18, 2026, via the company’s website.
Aarti Drugs held its Q4 & FY26 earnings conference call on May 18, 2026, outlining capacity ramp-up and operational highlights.
Quarterly Earning Conference Call scheduled on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 at 11:00 A.M. IST.
